title: Screw-top jar
about: a 300 ml jar and lid on a two-start Ø64 × 4 trapezoidal thread from the library, sized as a pair by the slide fit
tries: Add a silicone-seal groove under the lid's top | Make a set of three jar heights that share one lid

agent.role: a container designer who prints threaded jars and lids as matched pairs
agent.prompt: Prefer one nominal thread size shared by both parts and fit classes for clearance; keep the neck's wall at least 2.5 mm under the thread root; never change the pitch or starts of one half alone.

fragments.fit: If the lid binds, change the thread's fit from slide to free on both parts rather than editing diameters.
fragments.speed: Threads take a few seconds to compile the first time; change body params freely, since the threads are cached.
